extraction_notes: Forward-current, reverse-current, and junction-capacitance curves were digitized from the real characteristic plots on pp. 2-3 in SI units; points are approximate readings of plotted traces and no points were extrapolated beyond the plotted ranges.
The forward-voltage table publishes maximum instantaneous forward-voltage limits at IF = 1 mA, 10 mA, 50 mA, and 150 mA, all at TA = 25 degC.

The reverse-leakage table publishes a maximum of 5 nA at VR = 75 V and TA = 25 degC. The separate 80 uA maximum at VR = 75 V and Tj = 150 degC was transcribed as a distinct condition in this note and was not used as the room-temperature reverse-current input.

The total-capacitance table value is typical: 2.0 pF at VR = 0 V and f = 1 MHz. The reverse-recovery row gives typical 0.8 ns and maximum 3.0 ns under IF = IR = 10 mA, Irr = 0.1 x IR, and RL = 100 ohm; the schema scalar uses the maximum value.

The reverse-breakdown rating is 100 V at IR = 100 uA. This is a breakdown voltage/current test pair, distinct from the operating limits VRRM = 85 V and VRMS = 75 V. Other page-1 ratings include IF(AV) = 200 mA, power dissipation = 250 mW, Tj = 150 degC, and RthetaJ-A = 450 degC/W; the non-repetitive surge-current ratings are 4.0 A at tp = 1 us, 1.0 A at tp = 1 ms, and 0.5 A at tp = 1 s.
The surge-current and power-derating plots are not included as diode model curves because they are outside the required diode extraction fields.
extraction.omission_reason: The supplied datasheet provides the required forward, reverse-leakage, capacitance, reverse-recovery, and breakdown evidence. Surge-current and power-derating behavior is outside the strict diode extraction fields and was not included as model-input curves.

current.conditions: Conservative F1 package bench at 95% of the cited current; IF = 150 mA; TA = 25 degC
